title: Title bar shading flickers while scrolling the board
description: The window header loses its background shading during scroll and snaps back afterwards, so the title area changes colour as content moves under it. BoardView paints one continuous gradient in a ZStack with .ignoresSafeArea() behind the board, and the ScrollView sits inside that, so the title bar's own scroll-edge treatment fights the app-drawn gradient instead of blending with it. Look at macOS 26's .scrollEdgeEffectStyle(_:for:) and .scrollEdgeEffectHidden(_:for:) on the ScrollView, and .toolbarBackgroundVisibility(_:for:), to pick one owner of the top edge rather than two. Reproduce by scrolling the board vertically and watching the area behind the project name and the Change Project button.
notes: Fix applied in BoardView.swift: toolbarBackgroundVisibility(.visible, for: .windowToolbar) plus scrollEdgeEffectHidden(true, for: .top), so the toolbar is the sole owner of the top edge instead of the automatic toolbar background fading in and out over the app-drawn gradient. Builds clean. NOT visually verified - driving the board needs a signed-in session, so someone has to scroll it once to confirm the flicker is gone.

title: Fix Blocked column position in board order
description: Blocked sits between To Do and In Progress, which reads wrong - blocked work is a detour off In Progress, not a step before it. Cause: buildBoardData in BoardGrouping.swift sorts columns by statusCategory (new=0, indeterminate=1, done=2) and then alphabetically within a category. Jira reports both Blocked and In Progress as 'indeterminate', so 'Blocked' < 'In Progress' alphabetically and lands first. Options: order columns by the project's own board/workflow order from Jira instead of category+alpha, or special-case blocked-type statuses to sort after the other indeterminate ones. The web board (components/kanban/KanbanBoard.tsx CATEGORY_ORDER) has the same bug, so fix both or share the rule.
close_reason: Column sort is now category -> parked -> name in both clients. Parked = status name starting with blocked/on hold/waiting/paused/impediment, so Blocked lands after In Progress. 5 new BoardColumnOrderTests cover it; 12/12 native tests pass, tsc and eslint clean.

title: Make Jira sync fully async so drags feel instant
description: A drag currently updates optimistically but still feels latent: BoardViewModel.move awaits APIClient.moveIssue, which does a permissions GET and then a transition POST before clearing pendingKeys, and the card sits dimmed at 0.5 opacity for that whole round trip. Wanted: the drop is done the moment it lands - no dimming, no waiting - with the Jira write queued and reconciled in the background. Needs a durable outbox (survives the 30s poll and app relaunch), retry with backoff, coalescing of repeated moves of the same issue, and a non-blocking way to surface a write that ultimately failed and had to be rolled back.

title: Restore Liquid Glass look for board cards

Isolate which one actually fixed the lift (prime suspect: the lazy stack not materialising a lifted item), then reintroduce glass on the card if it survives. Note a drag preview is rendered detached from the window, so any backdrop-sampling material has nothing to sample there - glass on the card may need a painted fallback behind it, or the lift may need to render in-window.
